main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar forward return on forecast (mean_reversion grid bars, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 grid bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: mean excess 2-bar return over top quintile of positive forecasts > 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2, the top-quintile mean excess return is above 0, and there are at least 300 grid bars with forecast > 0.
reading: The coin's mean 2-bar return is taken over the non-overlapping 2-bar grid of all its bars in all windows, the regression is OLS with an intercept, the top quintile is positive-forecast grid bars at or above their 80th percentile, and the regime is read from the recorded `regime` column.
